column1: # Hand-written abilities, in the engine's notation, by Oracle of the Void
# card id.  One file serves every era: a card legal in several arcs is one
# record, and a line for a card not in an era's pool is skipped there.
# Timings: battle limited open battleopen enter static reveal
# Costs:   bow (this card)  destroy  gold:N  perf=KW/KW  bowperf=KW/KW
# Targets: none self opers epers apers efol afol ecard acard ocard eunit
# Conditions: att def home bowed unbowed opposed nofol noatt lowerforce
#          lowerchi lechi kw=X force<=N chi<=N ph>=N ph<=N
# Effects: force:N chi:N pforce:N pchi:N pph:N destroy bow bowunit
#          bowfollowers straighten home tobattle gain:N lose:N olose:N
#          draw:N odiscard:N ranged:N rangedchi melee:N fear:N fearchi
# A line encodes what the card does as faithfully as the notation allows;
# where it falls short, the note after the name says how.
